analyst.summary: UTL Solar (Fujiyama Power Systems) makes rooftop solar equipment -- panels, inverters, batteries and full systems -- for India's residential and small-commercial solar market, and has grown very fast and very profitably over several years. It does not pay a dividend, reinvesting instead in growth. We rate it a Hold: strong execution and returns, but very high growth rates rarely continue indefinitely, and forward order visibility was not available to independently verify from the sources reviewed.
